REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, August 15, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-j be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting held on July 26, 2017 and the Special Meeting held on August 1, 2017 and the Regular Meeting of August 1, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
June Treasurer Report
ACTION: That the June report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Consider Award a Professional Services Agreement with Buckman Infrastructure Group Inc. for the 2017 Pavement Management System Update
ACTION: That the City Council award a professional services agreement to Buckman Infrastructure Group Inc. in an amount of $23,238 to update the City's Pavement Management System; authorize a 10% contingency for unforeseen conditions; and authorize the City Manager to sign the agreement.
Item #7j
k.
Recommendation to award Parking Ticket Collection Services contract
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a professional services agreement with Data Ticket Inc., to provide parking ticket collection services for the City of Lomita from November 1, 2017 to October 31, 2022 further authorize the purchase of handheld electronic ticket writers and printers as necessary for use by staff.
Item #7k
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - LOMITA ALEHOUSE SPECIAL PERMIT APPEAL 24123 NARBONNE AVENUE
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Res 2017-32 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving Special Permits for coin-operated games of skill (video games), pool and billiard tables, and an entertainment license for live music and dancing for Lomita Alehouse located at 24123 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Item#8
9.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, September 5, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
